bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
page_notes: Funny-animal (Supermouse). LIGHT-ON-DARK case: the newsreel screen in panel 1 is white lettering on a black screen. Two coloured display sound effects (POW!?, SMACK!). Rounded cartoon lettering, upper case, with bold-italic emphasis words and a scroll caption at the end. Low-ish resolution source (about 9-11 px letters).

regions.text: LATEST NEWS FLASHES OUR HERO DOES IT AGAIN! THE REAL-LIFE RESCUE OF STARRY STARR BY-- SUPERMOUSE!
regions.notes: Newsreel title card on a cinema screen: white upright lettering on black, in four sizes (LATEST largest; NEWS FLASHES; small body lines; SUPERMOUSE! italic). Read as one block. The dash after BY is drawn as two short dashes.

regions.text: NOW THAT'S MORE LIKE IT! OH, SOUPIE--YOU'RE A REAL HERO!
regions.notes: 'THAT'S', 'REAL' and 'HERO!' are bold italic. 'SOUPIE--' ends a line; joined to YOU'RE as a reader reads it. Drawn 'OH,SOUPIE' with no space after the comma.
Lettered 'UNDER-' / 'STAND!' across a line break; written as the whole word. 'B-BUT' is a stammer, kept.
Red outlined display letters on a pale yellow panel; ends in '!' followed by a '?'-like hook (drawn as '!?' fused). Read as POW!? ; an engine reading POW! or POW!! is understandable.

regions.text: YA MEAN YA LIKED THE SHORT SUBJECT BETTER THAN THE MAIN PICTURE? BUT THAT WAS ONLY ME--SUPERMOUSE--NOT SYLVAN SMOOTHIE!
regions.notes: 'MAIN PICTURE', 'ME' and 'SUPER-' / 'MOUSE' are bold italic. SUPERMOUSE is broken 'SUPER-' / 'MOUSE' across lines and written whole. Dashes are drawn as two short strokes with uneven spacing ('ME -- SUPER-'); written as '--' without spaces.

regions.text: THAT'S WHY I LIKED IT! MOVIE STARS COME AND GO--BUT THERE'S ONLY ONE SUPERMOUSE!
regions.notes: 'ONLY ONE SUPERMOUSE!' is bold italic. The dash after GO is drawn as two dots/short strokes.
Pink/red outlined display letters on a light blue background, partly overlapping the balloon tail.

regions.text: G-GOSH! ISN'T THIS WORLD JUST PERFECT?
DON'T MISS THAT SUPER SUPERMOUSE IN OUR NEXT ISSUE!
regions.notes: Scroll-shaped caption at the bottom; 'SUPERMOUSE' bold italic. Drawn 'ISSUE !' with a space.
